items.title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
items.content: We’re sharing an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, including a writeup and a formal proof in Lean.
items.contentSnippet: We’re sharing an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, including a writeup and a formal proof in Lean.

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了人工智能生成的纳维-斯托克斯千禧年大奖难题解决方案，包括详细说明和Lean系统中的正式证明。该方案旨在解决这一流体力学中的核心数学问题，展示了AI在复杂科学问题上的应用潜力。
summaries.en: The article announces the sharing of an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem. items.title: Funding grants for new research into AI and teen development
items.content: Apply now for OpenAI’s $5 million grant program supporting independent research on how generative AI affects teen development, well-being, and safety.
items.contentSnippet: Apply now for OpenAI’s $5 million grant program supporting independent research on how generative AI affects teen development, well-being, and safety.

summaries.zh: OpenAI宣布启动一项500万美元的资助计划，支持独立研究团队探讨生成式AI对青少年发展、身心健康及安全的影响。申请现已开放，旨在促进相关领域的研究。
summaries.en: OpenAI is offering a $5 million grant program to fund independent research on the impact of generative AI on teen development, well-being, and safety. Applications are now open for researchers to explore this topic. The initiative aims to provide insights into how AI technologies influence adolescents.

items.title: Supporting independent journalism in Ukraine
items.content: OpenAI, AIRPPU and WAN-IFRA launch an AI program to help Ukrainian news organizations strengthen innovation, resilience, and independent journalism.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI, AIRPPU and WAN-IFRA launch an AI program to help Ukrainian news organizations strengthen innovation, resilience, and independent journalism.

summaries.zh: OpenAI、AIRPPU和WAN-IFRA联合启动AI项目，旨在支持乌克兰新闻机构，提升其创新能力和韧性，保障独立新闻报道。该项目致力于通过技术手段帮助乌克兰媒体应对挑战，维护新闻自由。
summaries.en: OpenAI, AIRPPU, and WAN-IFRA have launched an AI program to assist Ukrainian news organizations. The initiative aims to enhance innovation, resilience, and the practice of independent journalism in the country. The program is designed to provide resources and support for news outlets facing challenges.
